question: What recovery guarantee should the experimental grouped-update command provide after an external package installer or Gateway scheduler mutation cannot be proven compensated?
rationale: The code deliberately preserves uncertain state and reports `update_partial`, but the appropriate operator experience—documented manual inspection/replan versus a durable doctor/reconcile operation identity—is a product and operational-support choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Prove and retain manual recovery
options.body: Require exact-head live package and Gateway failure/retry proof, then keep the experimental contract as fail closed with visible diagnosis and explicit re-planning.

options.title: Add durable reconcile support first
options.body: Require an operation identity plus doctor/retry/reconcile behavior before allowing this mutation stage to merge.

options.title: Defer grouped apply
options.body: Keep the read-only planner and postpone this executor until the recovery contract is sponsored and validated.

recommendation.title: Prove and retain manual recovery
recommendation.body: Require exact-head live package and Gateway failure/retry proof, then keep the experimental contract as fail closed with visible diagnosis and explicit re-planning.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer identified the unresolved external-mutation recovery boundary that requires an explicit maintainer decision.
